title: Jacquard bodycon Mermaid Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
This mesh floral applique dress combines the sophistication of jacquard texture with the delicacy of fine embroidery, creating a gown that feels both modern and timeless. The fitted bodice highlights the waistline, while the elegant floral applique design elongates the silhouette and brings a touch of artistry to every detail.

The cap sleeves and soft mesh overlay offer gentle coverage, while the floor-length hem flows gracefully with each step¡ªmaking this dress perfect for women who want to balance elegance with comfort. Whether you¡¯re attending a wedding, a black-tie gala, or an upscale evening celebration, this embroidered jacquard dress will showcase your natural curves and highlight your femininity with effortless charm.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises knit.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
